o.text: Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish قمو (qamu), from Proto-Turkic *kamug, possibly later influenced by Persian همه (hame). Compare Turkish kamu.
Internationalism; via Russian эпопе́я (epopéja), ultimately from French épopée.
